definition: Parallel Web Systems is an American artificial intelligence infrastructure company headquartered in Palo Alto, California.
details: The company develops application programming interfaces (APIs) and a web index designed for use by AI agents rather than human users.

explainer.lead: Parallel Web Systems is an American artificial intelligence infrastructure company headquartered in Palo Alto, California. It matters because it builds a web index and APIs aimed at AI agents rather than human users.

tiers.eli5: Most websites are built for people to browse; this company builds web tools made for AI programs to read and use.
tiers.practitioner: Developers targeting AI agents can use the company's APIs and web index instead of human-oriented interfaces. Note that the available facts describe only the company and its intended customers, not its internals.
tiers.paperLevel: Parallel Web Systems is an American artificial intelligence infrastructure company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, developing application programming interfaces (APIs) and a web index designed for use by AI agents rather than human users.

explainer.example: An agent needing current web information queries the company's API and web index rather than scraping pages designed for human browsing.
